name: Supreme x Nike Air Max 95 Lux 'Black'
story_html: Part of a trio of colorways released for November 2019, the Supreme x Air Max 95 Lux 'Black' sneaker is a premium take on the iconic Nike Air Max 95 model. Dressing its wavy, anatomy-inspired panels in full Italian leather, the cult skate brand delivers a fashion-forward twist on the legendary, Sergio Lozano Air Max design with a laser perforated SUPREME logo on the sides. This ultra-sleek, blacked-out version is finished with a full-length Air-sole unit which grounds the design in heritage style.
